gaps.card: An attacker can rm -rf / or ~, drop a fork-bomb, dd/mkfs a device, or unpack a tar-bomb.
gaps.ruleSketch: line-pattern probes for `rm -rf /|~`, `:(){ :|:& };:`, `dd if=/dev/zero of=`, `mkfs`, and unbounded `yes |` / `while true` spawning.
gaps.status: SHIPPED at ruleset 0.7.0 — class `resource-exhaustion` (3 rules: recursive-delete-root, fork-bomb, raw-disk-destroy)
gaps.rationale: ABSENT cell, highest user value, purely pattern-tier, deterministic + never-executing, zero new deps.

gaps.card: An attacker can clear shell history or truncate/disable logs to erase the trail.
gaps.ruleSketch: line-pattern probes for `history -c`, `rm ~/.bash_history`, `unset HISTFILE`, `git reflog expunge`, writes/truncation of `/var/log/*`, `journalctl --rotate`.
gaps.status: SHIPPED at ruleset 0.7.0 — class `audit-evasion` (2 rules: history-clearing, log-tampering)
gaps.rationale: ABSENT cell; maps to MAESTRO L5 (observability integrity); fully static + deterministic.

gaps.card: An attacker can publish under a typosquatted name, claim a false repository/homepage, or name an MCP tool to mimic a built-in.
gaps.ruleSketch: builtin: manifest name edit-distance-1/homoglyph vs a shipped popular-name list; declared repository disagreeing with acquired git origin; MCP tool name mimicking Read/Bash.
gaps.rationale: THIN cell (only text-impersonation today); needs a small shipped allow-list, no network.

gaps.card: An attacker can sudo / chmod +s / write /etc/sudoers.d, or install persistence (cron, systemd unit, ~/.bashrc, git hook).
gaps.ruleSketch: line-pattern probes for `sudo`, `chmod +s`, `setcap`, `/etc/sudoers.d`, crontab writes, systemd unit drops, profile/rc appends, git-hook installs.
gaps.rationale: HEAVY cell but missing the sudo/setuid + persistence shapes; deterministic, deepens E.

gaps.card: An attacker can make a skill rewrite its own SKILL.md/manifest or .claude/settings.json at runtime (a rug-pull feeder).
gaps.ruleSketch: line-pattern probes for a script writing to its own SKILL.md/plugin.json or to .claude/settings.json.
gaps.rationale: Deepens T and links to the temporal axis; pattern-tier.

gaps.card: An attacker can harvest env / .npmrc / .netrc and pipe to the network.
gaps.ruleSketch: extend the T1 taint source set with env/printenv/.npmrc/.netrc reads reaching a network sink (no new class; widen the existing analyzer).
gaps.rationale: Deepens an already-HEAVY cell by extending the existing taint analyzer rather than adding a class.

gaps.card: A skill ships real PII (emails, names, phone numbers) in fixtures/logs/committed data.
gaps.ruleSketch: line-pattern PII probes (email, phone, national-id shapes) over data/fixture files.
gaps.rationale: Proves the threat-map is open to multiple frameworks (LINDDUN), not only STRIDE. Graduate when there is corpus evidence.
